overall_reason: A dark shadcn token layer holds most components (12px card radius on 70 elements, two text colours, one cyan accent), but the alternate theme block redefines a third of the semantic colours and layers climb through bracketed z-index values.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY and T-SCALE-FIT mostly pass (radius on_token 0.82, spacing 100% on 4px); T-THEME-PARITY fails on the partial alternate theme (TOK-009) and T-LADDER on bracketed layers (TOK-005).

findings.evidence: theme.semantic_colour_redefined_share is 0.326: the class-based theme blocks redefine 15 of 46 semantic colour tokens, and --background, --foreground, --card, --primary, --border, --muted and --accent are not among them (semantic_colour_not_redefined). light_tokens_class_or_attr is 15.
findings.before: An alternate theme that swaps 15 of 46 roles
findings.after: Either ship one theme and drop the partial block, or redefine every semantic colour in it
findings.why: A theme switch would leave surfaces, text and the accent in the dark values.

findings.where: video card badges and labels; 1440 and 375 (tiles/1440-01.png onward)
findings.evidence: values.1440.font_size includes 9px (span.absolute.top-2 badges on the video cards, 4 elements), 10px and 11px (span.text-[11px].uppercase) beside the 12 and 14px steps; the type_ladder sweep counts 10 sizes.
findings.after: One label step (text-xs, 12px) for badges and card meta
findings.why: Three sub-12px sizes do one labelling job.

findings.where: stylesheet layers; floating help button and nav
findings.evidence: declarations.arbitrary_value_selectors includes .z-[60], .z-[90], .z-[100], .z-[120], .z-[200], .z-[300], .z-[9998], .z-[9999] and .z-[10000]. Rendered values are 0, 10, 20, 50, 100.
findings.before: Layer values typed per component up to 10000
findings.after: A named layer ladder in the theme
findings.why: Bracketed layers grow by escalation and collide when new overlays are added.

strengths: One card radius (12px) on 70 elements, 82% on a token, the same at 375.
Text uses two colours by role (#e7ebef headings, #a9b5c6 body) and one cyan accent (#12c0e2) with alpha steps.
not_investigated: The literal colours in the stylesheet (#ffffff, #2d2d2d, #3367d9) belong to third-party CSS (driver.js tour, React Flow, Sonner) and were not counted against the page.
The alternate theme was read from the stylesheet only and never rendered.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (AI video studio landing page); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
